title: 第17章 作弊第18章 欠条
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 宗主不在的情况下，副宗主全权负责天剑宗一切事务。
他都说了，秦易利用那柄疑似地品的木剑作弊，隔绝了剑术天梯的剑气冲击，从而让其轻松登顶九十九层。
其他人恍然大悟，纷纷指责秦易，并且还出言嘲讽七长老。
与七长老素来不和的六长老以及三长老，更是趁机要求副宗主，取消七长老招收弟子的权利。
“你们……有什么证据？”
七长老面目狰狞，不管怎么样，他都相信，秦易不会作弊。
而且。
从来没有听说，用厉害的兵器，就能隔绝剑术天梯的剑气冲击。
这是什么逻辑？
“七长老，你还在嘴硬？那柄木剑，绝对是地品兵器。”六长老道，“你不会不知道，地品兵器有多强吧？”
兵器的等级，也是分为天地玄黄。
最次的是黄品兵器，其次是玄品，然后是地品跟天品。
凡俗势力，基本上都是黄品兵器，而天剑宗这种江州仙宗，弟子们所使用的都是玄品兵器。
至于地品兵器，整个天剑宗也没有几件。
甚至有人怀疑，秦易手中的地品木剑，极有可能是七长老送给他的，为的就是让他登顶剑术天梯。
“这是我天剑宗的耻辱。”
三长老摇头。
七长老百口莫辩，他最后无助的看向副宗主。
副宗主一甩衣袖，转身离开。
他的态度表明了一切，三长老派系的高层们，也是留下了嘲讽的话语，而后离开。
围观弟子们，则是纷纷摇头。
原本以为真的出现了一位妖孽天才，没想到他居然作弊，简直令人不齿。
热闹的天剑山，一下子冷清下来。
七长老木讷的站在山顶上，内心充满了怒火。
就在这时。
秦易从剑术天梯上走了下来。
依稀能够看到，他的身上，有一层剑道符文闪烁。
他走下剑术天梯的那一刻。
剑术天梯上的光芒，逐渐消失，到最后彻底沉寂了下来。
谁也不知道。
这是剑术天梯对先天剑种的敬意。
content_en:
In the absence of the sect leader, the deputy sect leader is fully responsible for all affairs of the Tianjian Sect.
He had already said that Qin Yi used the wooden sword that was suspected to be of high quality to cheat and isolate the sword energy impact of the swordsmanship ladder, allowing him to easily reach the top of the ninety-ninth floor.
Others suddenly realized this and accused Qin Yi one after another, and even mocked the Seventh Elder.
The Sixth Elder and the Third Elder, who had always been at odds with the Seventh Elder, took the opportunity to ask the deputy sect leader to cancel the Seventh Elder's right to recruit disciples.
"What evidence do you...have?"
The seventh elder looked ferocious. No matter what, he believed that Qin Yi would not cheat.
and.
I have never heard that using powerful weapons can isolate the sword energy impact of the swordsmanship ladder.
What is the logic of this?
"Seventh Elder, are you still being stubborn? That wooden sword is definitely an Earth-grade weapon." The Sixth Elder said, "You don't know how powerful an Earth-grade weapon is, right?"
The levels of weapons are also divided into heaven and earth, black and yellow.
The lowest ranked weapons are Huang-grade weapons, followed by Xuan-grade weapons, and then Earth-grade and Heaven-grade weapons.
Mortal forces basically all use yellow-grade weapons, but the disciples of Jiangzhou Immortal Sect such as Tianjian Sect use all Xuan-grade weapons.
As for earth-grade weapons, there are only a few in the entire Tianjian Sect.
Some people even suspect that the earth-grade wooden sword in Qin Yi's hand was most likely given to him by the seventh elder in order to help him climb the swordsmanship ladder.
"This is a shame to our Heavenly Sword Sect."
The third elder shook his head.
The seventh elder couldn't argue, and he finally looked helplessly at the deputy sect master.
The deputy sect leader flicked his sleeves and turned to leave.
His attitude showed everything. The senior officials of the Three Elders Faction also left mocking words and then left.
The disciples who were watching shook their heads.
I originally thought that a monster genius really appeared, but I didn't expect that he actually cheated, which is simply disgusting.
The bustling Tianjian Mountain suddenly became deserted.
The seventh elder stood dullly on the top of the mountain, his heart filled with anger.
Just then.
Qin Yi walked down the swordsmanship ladder.
It can be vaguely seen that there is a layer of sword runes flickering on his body.
The moment he stepped down the swordsmanship ladder.
The light on the swordsmanship ladder gradually disappeared, and finally became completely silent.
No one knows.
This is the swordsmanship ladder's respect for the innate sword species.
